what: FM Necrobinder starts with 8000 max HP
Enemy max/current HP multiplied at combat start
Damage dealt by enemies multiplied
Block gained by enemies multiplied so their defenses match the scale
Enemy flat damage-affecting powers (Strength) multiplied
Start of turn: draw until hand has 5 cards
FM cards are never discarded at end of turn
All FM cards cost 0 energy
Only one monster summon (single or fusion chain) per turn; spells unlimited
Right-click a monster in hand to mark it with the next fusion number; right-click again to unmark
Playing any marked card fuses all marked cards in order using the disc fusion table; mismatches drop the earlier card
After summoning, a choice window offers Attack or Defense
Osty becomes the summoned FM monster with 1 HP; any enemy hit that gets past Block destroys it, whatever its ATK
The monster is shown as the game NCard of its FM card (CanvasGroup), upright in Attack, sideways in Defense
Attack position at end of your turn: Osty hits its target (or a random enemy) for ATK
Defense position at end of your turn: the duelist gains Block = DEF (the game blocks hits on Osty with its owner's Block)
Fusions resulting in level 5+ Dragons fail unless Dragon Treasure relic owned
Neow offers Dragon Treasure relic: unlocks dragon fusions and adds Baby Dragon + Petit Dragon
Card rewards draw from FM pool using per-act rarity columns; StS rarity odds apply
Normal/elite fights: random FM track (all non-jingle tracks), kept for 2 floors; bosses and rest sites fixed (media.json)
Fusion mark / draw sounds from disc
Reads the player's FM disc image path from %APPDATA%/FMDuelist/settings.cfg (FM_DISC) and parses cards, fusions, equips, art
ATK/DEF toggle button on the monster switches position for this turn
Three monster zones (zone 1 = Osty, zones 2-3 = FmZonePet pets). Summon asks for a zone; an occupied zone fuses with its monster first
When the monster dies its card sprite burns away (shader dissolve) with FM destroy SFX if decodable
Attack position hit: if hit <= monster ATK the attacker takes ATK back; if hit > ATK no hit-back and the duelist takes the difference
Enemy attack total (all hits summed) <= Defense block: leftover block dealt back to attacker
Click the monster card: game targeting arrow; chosen enemy is attacked (card flies into it, hit fx, flies back); once per turn, else auto at end of turn
Standard StS deck cycle: played cards go to discard and reshuffle; no FM card exhausts
Monster on field: duelist takes no enemy damage; per hit in Attack: hit-back ATK, duelist takes (hit - ATK) if positive, monster destroyed; Defense: Block soaks, unbroken Block reflects remainder
The monster only loses HP to enemy powered attacks (never from its own attacks, thorns or self-damage)
Each hit of a multi-hit attack is calculated separately (hit-back, excess damage, reflect)
Hovering the field monster or a zone card shows the full card, stats, equips and FM text
Row above the duelist: set traps face-down, field spell, equips, Swords with turns left
25 Millennium Item / character relics in the Necrobinder pool (sheets/relics.json)
Field spells fade the combat backdrop into their own card art (blurred, tinted): Forest, Wasteland, Mountain, Sogen, Umi (sea), Yami (darkness)
During FM runs the colorless pool = 24 FM rituals + 6 FM support magic (pool column = colorless)
Summoning while a monster is on the field: the field monster is the first card of the fusion chain (animated)

Every non-FM damage/Block number is x100 (enemy attacks, thorns, poison, statuses, base relics/potions/powers on the duelist); FM effects use raw FM numbers; enemy Strength/Dexterity/Thorns/Poison/Constrict/BlockNextTurn display x100
FM runs: base-game flat HP loss, heals and max-HP changes under 200 are x100 (events, relics, potions, Neow, enemy regen); FM effects are raw
Relics/potions/events in sheets/removed_energy.json never appear in FM runs (energy + card upgrades); reward upgrade odds are 0
Card reward Skip completes (discards) the reward
Rest site: Smith replaced by Cut, which removes up to (act index + 1) cards: Act 1: 1, Act 2: 2, Act 3: 3
Enemy attacks land on the front living zone (1, then 2, then 3)
At most 3 traps set at once
Rest sites play FM's Build Deck music (media.json restSite_BuildDeck)
Each act's starting room plays media.json actStartRoom (act 1: 44, act 2: 26, act 3: game music)
Beating an act boss plays media.json bossVictoryFanfare (track 46) once
Neow option Exodia Card Box adds the 5 Forbidden One pieces (17-21). All 5 in hand: animation, every enemy killed. Pieces never in rewards or shops
Only with the Exodia Card Box: deck cannot be cut (rest Cut, shop removal) below 15; the box tops the deck up to 15
In FM runs all text matches the x100 effects: relic/potion/event numbers (<200, not %), enemy power tooltips and icons, base-card damage/Block previews
Losing: track 47 (You Lose) once, then 3 s later track 48 (Game Over) once
Dark Hole destroys all your monsters and blocks summoning for the rest of that turn
After the company logos, MOVIE.STR movie 1 plays (MDEC v2 + XA, decoded from the disc); click/key skips
Main menu backdrop = intro frame 255 (FM logo on the flaming stone wall); menu buttons unchanged; menu music track 00
Act 1: 20% per card reward to swap in a random weak Dragon (lv<=4); Act 2: weak Common, strong Uncommon; Act 3: all Dragons Common; Act 1 shops: 40% per visit that one card is a weak Dragon
Act map theme (also events/shops/treasure): media.json actMap (act 1: track 10)
A monster that attacked this turn can't switch to Defense until next turn
Only one Raigeki (337) or Dark Hole (336) can be played per turn
Currency is Star Chips: Gold/coin text renamed in every loc table; gold icons replaced with the mod's own star chip art (dist/FMDuelist/star_chip.png)
Shop music per act: Act 1 #15, Act 2 #9, Act 3 #15 (media.actShop)
Dragging a hand monster's arrow onto your own field monster fuses onto it; that field monster leads the chain, then any right-click-marked cards in order, then the dragged card if unmarked
Before the first Act 1 battle: popup with FM rules, fusing, junk cards and a cheat sheet computed from the disc fusion table (no 'don't show again'; Fusion Guide button reopens it)
Remaining potions/relics take an FM card's name, flavor and art from the disc (sheets/retheme.json, built by tools/make_retheme.py); effects unchanged
Character select plays FM track 44 (media.characterSelect); every looping track now loops seamlessly at its loop-end point with the release tail folded into the loop start
Necrobinder is renamed Duel Master K (he/him, Duel Monsters description); portrait from local duel_master_k.png if present (never shipped), else game art
Base-game cards added to an FM player's piles become FM cards: Strike -> random heal spell (338-341), Defend -> random trap (681-690), other -> random FM pool card; curses/statuses untouched
Block multipliers in FM runs give +1000 DEF until next turn instead: Fortifier (one chosen monster), Pael's Legion (all your monsters, when a block spell is played)
Transform: monster -> random monster of higher rarity (basic: C55/U33/R12; common: U75/R25; uncommon/rare: R100); spell/trap/equip/ritual -> random spell/trap/equip (C60/U30/R10); never Exodia

Equips are dragged onto one compatible monster (arrow only highlights monsters that can use it); bonus stays while that monster is on the field; FM-style equip animation (card spins in, flash, shine sweep) + synthesized equip sound

Statuses/curses can be marked: harmless junk is knocked away (failed fusion, discarded); junk with an in-hand turn-end effect destroys the current monster and is exhausted; leading junk waits for the first monster

Frantic Escape (sand worm) = Step Back: uses the turn's summon, stacks only with marked Frantic Escapes (1-5 steps), no cost growth; tutorial tab 'Junk Cards' explains junk and Step Back with pictures
Neow shows 3 choices; Dragon Treasure 35% and Exodia Card Box 15% roll independently and replace normal choices
Starter monsters are drawn fresh each run: 14 Common non-Dragon monsters (ATK<=1000, Lv<=3), one per type first; starter spells unchanged
First 5 normal fights of Act 1 play track 32; random battle pool afterwards

Per-monster attack animation: style from type + name/card-text keywords (slash, claw, bite, sting, fireball, breath, lightning, water, magic, holy, dark, laser, rock, vines, wind); colors from card art + attribute; size by ATK, hits by level
Summon animation: card drops in spinning, golden light pillar, floor ring, sparkles
Raigeki plays a synthesized thunderclap (crack + rolling rumble) layered with the game's lightning SFX
Strength gain = Sun Star (+500 ATK all monsters until next turn), Dexterity gain = Moon Star (+500 DEF); game power removed immediately; items show planet icons (sheets/guardian_stars.json)
Each enemy hit picks a monster: 1) Attack-position monster it overpowers (excess to LP, biggest first); 2) one it destroys (ATK/DEF below hit); 3) least hit-back (Defense first, then lowest ATK)

Enemy tactics (FmEnemyAI): value(attack m)=1.5*threat(m)+1.2*LP spill - hit-back*boldness*(1+2*back/life); never suicidal; value(defend)=0.8*min(your unspent attack-position ATK, its total hit)*(1+0.75*missing HP%); boss 0.55 / elite 0.75 / normal 1.0 boldness; defend = banner + Block equal to the skipped damage; a Defense monster whose DEF the hit exceeds is a clean kill: value>=1.5*threat+0.6*hit+400-0.25*risk and always beats defending
Duelist Plating: +200 DEF per level to all monsters instead of end-of-turn Block; still -1 at the start of each turn; enemy Plating unchanged
Attack-position monsters no longer auto-attack at end of turn; they attack only when clicked

Field cards swap the whole combat background to a StS location: Forest=overgrowth, Wasteland=the_insatiable_boss, Mountain=waterfall_giant_boss, Sogen=the_kin_boss, Umi=underdocks, Yami=vantom_boss; one field active at a time
Dark Hole (336) is unplayable if any of your monsters attacked this turn

Boss duelists (FmRival.Bosses): Act1 The Kin -> Young Priest Seto (FM duelist #7), Act2 Knowledge Demon -> "Final" Duelist (#17 Seto Kaiba, World Tournament finals), Act3 Queen -> Final Priest Seto (#36 Seto 3rd); 8000 LP each, minions removed, own moves replaced by the duel, 3 monster zones, FM rules

Unique heal animations + synthesized sounds: Mooyan Curry (eat), Red Medicine (drink, red), Goblin's Secret Remedy (bubbling flask), Soul of the Pure (descending soul), Dian Keto (Healing Light pillar + cross), Eternal Draught (drink, blue); shared healing chime

Healing ladder 338<339<340<341<342: heal + heal = one step above the stronger (Dian Keto caps); any card can be right-click marked; non-fusing spells/traps/rituals in a chain are knocked away (discarded)

In a monster chain, spells/traps/rituals and equips that don't fit are the card knocked away (failed fusion) and the monster carries on to be summoned; cards marked before the first monster meet it when it arrives
Exoskeletons removed: Hive no longer offers ExoskeletonsNormal/Weak; saved runs' Exoskeleton rooms spawn Bowlbugs (BowlbugRock) instead
Main menu: every Timeline epoch revealed, every relic/card/potion/event marked seen, menu buttons never locked

Timeline button -> FM Library: searchable/sortable/filterable list of all 722 disc cards with art + details + fuses-into, Fusion Calculator (5 slots, best order), plays FM track 45; Compendium card library shows FM cards only
End of your turn: more than 5 cards in hand -> choose the excess to discard (manual choice; base-game discard prompts already only auto-pick when every card must go)

Summons can be cancelled (Skip) at the zone choice, and at the position choice for a plain summon; the card returns to hand with marks kept; no cancel once a fusion chain/field fusion is used or for rituals
